detail: Rakam Infrastructures Private Limited submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This regulation requires disclosure within four working days of crossing the 5% shareholding threshold. The filing confirms an acquisition event affecting Almondz Global Securities Limited, a listed financial services company. Transaction quantum, timing, and completion status are not detailed in the disclosure excerpt provided.
